sys.t001: What is different from the original game
sys.t002: If you are returning from another server, these are the changes you will notice first.
sys.t007: Every enemy shows an HP bar. De Rol Le and Barba Ray were fixed later so the bar tracks the real body HP.
sys.t009: The name colour tells you whether Demon's and Hell will work. Details in the next section.
sys.t011: With Jointparts and Celestial Fusion equipped and both techniques at Lv30, Jellen and Zalure are cast at the same time.
sys.t013: While the back palette is held, keys 0 and 1 also switch to the back palette, giving ten extra palette slots.
sys.t015: The update that made combo bonuses, custom motions and changed hit patterns possible at all.
sys.t017: Warps added in multi mode for Episodes 1, 2 and 4, and the lobby 1 spawn moved next to the counter.
sys.t019: Anything that used to cap at 99 now holds up to 250.
sys.t021: Drops randomly in Seabed, Tower and Sub Desert 3 on Ultimate, at the same rate as Luck material.
sys.t023: Monofluid, Difluid, Antidote, Antiparalysis and Trap Vision no longer drop on Ultimate. Trimate, Trifluid and Moon and Star Atomizer appear more often instead.
sys.t025: On Ultimate, parts such as P-Arms and Bringer's arm drop directly as the finished weapon.
sys.t027: Ruins 1 to 3 with Recoboxes at 3,000,000 HP, a 100 Photon Blast machine, an auto-revive mode and an NPC that gives 999,999 Meseta.
sys.t029: Battle 1 [Advanced] and Battle 2 [Advanced] were added, including 2 on 2 in a four player room.
sys.t031: Simulator 2.0 no longer sends you back to the city on death. World of Illusion is planned next.
sys.t035: Set message speed to 'fastest'. Boss skill names scroll past before the attack lands, and the faster setting gives you more time to react. Recommended for every raid.
sys.t036: The Starlight Tower, Distorted Nightmare and The Manipulated Tower require the widescreen client (psobbw.exe). A 4:3 client cannot run them.
sys.t037: If area-of-effect markers are hard to see, use the Effect Pack linked in the Discord guides channel.
sys.t039: Instant-kill specials do not work on everything. The name colour tells you before you waste a combo.
sys.t045: Immune to Demon's and Hell. Some of these enemies also have more than 32,767 HP.
sys.t047: Immune to Demon's and Hell. On a boss it also means very high HP or a damage reduction barrier.
sys.t048: Using Demon's on an immune enemy shows the text IMMUNE in purple, so you can confirm it in the middle of a fight.
sys.t049: A purple name means the enemy is immune.
sys.t050: The IMMUNE text shown when the special is blocked.
sys.t051: Area% - where high percentages come from
sys.t052: A weapon's attribute and Hit percentage are decided by the area it drops in, not by the monster. Every area carries three Area% levels, and each level caps how high a roll can go.
sys.t055: So a 100% Hit weapon can only come from an area that has a level 4 among its three values. Ruins 3, Seabed Lower - Tower, Sub Desert 3, Saint Million and the EP4 boss map are all 4/4/4.
sys.t063: The first six columns are the chance of each attribute appearing, and they always add up to 100. None means the weapon drops with no attribute.
sys.t064: This is a snapshot from 19 July 2026. Earlier patch notes list lower Area% values for Episode 4, so the levels have been raised over time. The original screenshots are below if you want to check.

sys.t066: The roll weight table behind each Area% level, for reference.
sys.t068: Ver.0.8133 brought Episode 2 Hit% chances in line with Episodes 1 and 4. Every Section ID now has the same odds.
sys.t069: The chance of a weapon dropping with no attribute was reduced in the later Episode 2 and Episode 4 areas.

sys.t073: Destiny changes a number of things the original Blue Burst never had. This page collects those changes, and the area table that decides which percentages a weapon can roll.
